snippet.title: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare Official Promotion Movie
snippet.description:
Add to Steam® Wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4372780/

In a probability spacetime bordering "Muv-Luv Alternative," a sky-piercing tower looms overhead.
Here, one young woman's tale of resolve and determination begins.

The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a single-player tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.
